content: {"episode_id":"ep-05028","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"The patient has recurrent palpitations and a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks, raising concern for undiagnosed paroxysmal atrial fibrillation as a potential embolic source. Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period. The study aims to guide anticoagulation therapy and rate control management based on the burden of atrial fibrillation detected. Reconsideration is requested on these documented clinical grounds, acknowledging that the CO-197 denial concerns missing prior authorization."}
